notes.title: IMPORTANT INFORMATION
notes.notes: [h1]Hi everyone![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/6d4ef2fe68a69571e35713c345d57c7154988d5d.png"][/img][/p][h2]After a while, I was finally able to upload a new update for Dead World. I know it took me a while, and I want to tell you why: I had a major project loss due to a disk issue, and that forced me to redo several parts from scratch.[/h2][h2]It was a tough blow, but I didn't want to leave the game hanging. With a lot of effort, I managed to recover a lot of it and also took the opportunity to make some changes to the story of The Lost Wagon and Gino's Journey, which now have a more solid and coherent foundation.[/h2][h2]As for the "A Rogue's Tale" mode, it was also lost, and I have to redo almost everything, so it will be available again in a few days. As soon as I have it ready, I'll upload it with another update.[/h2][h2]Thanks to everyone who continues to support the project, and I hope you understand what happened. I'm developing this game alone, and every step, no matter how small, takes time.[/h2][h2]More improvements and new features are coming soon. Thanks for your patience and for being a part of Dead World![/h2][p][/p][h2]– Juan Ignacio Ferreyra (Milanesa Studio)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551773/40c8dd8ea272e214371898a1e0c8ea42b462b026.png"][/img][/p]
- Fixed the bug that caused Gino to not appear on the chair in "Gino's Journey"

- The weapon "Carneadora" has been added to "Un Rogue Piola"
- Three new achievements have been added.
- Bug fixes have been made.
- Fixed a bug where enemies wouldn't move in "Un Rogue Piola"

notes.notes:

Story 2: Gino's Journey

Gino is a schnauzer from a settlement in La Payunia, Mendoza, considered the last of his kind. When a female schnauzer is discovered in a remote settlement, Daniel and Manuel decide to embark on a dangerous journey to save the schnauzer breed.
